messages:
Marcus (Finance): Heads-up — ACME reported lower embed counts for March APAC region, they're asking for a credit. They sent invoice + sample logs. :frowning_face:
Li (Eng): looking. any manifest of numbers? pinging @Anna (SRE) and billing-bot for meter traces.
Marcus (Finance): attached summary: ACME claims 1.9M embeds from their client logs but our ledger shows ~1.08M. They suspect regional proxy dedupe during failover.
Li (Eng): possible — we had a regional proxy patch on 2026-03-12 that introduced a suppression window for repeated requests when upstream timed out. I'll pull the ingest logs.
Anna (SRE): @Li I can run a replay on the APAC ingest shard. need the invoice window and connector id to scope.
Marcus (Finance): window 2026-03-10 to 2026-03-15, connector id acme-cust-42. customer pasted sample req ids: req_aaa123, req_bbb456.
billing-bot: Metering alert: possible duplicate suppression rule applied to APAC proxy from 2026-03-12T02:48:00Z to 2026-03-12T03:12:00Z (rule id proxy-dedupe-v2).
Li (Eng): running quick ledger query now, snippet: ```
SELECT count(*) FROM embed_events
 WHERE connector_id='acme-cust-42' AND region='apac'
 AND ts BETWEEN '2026-03-10' AND '2026-03-15';
``` getting ~1,080,345 on master ledger.
Anna (SRE): replay findings: replayed 2026-03-12 02:48-03:12 window for acme-cust-42 — replayed events = 795,210; previously ingested = 38,240. Looks like dedupe suppression swallowed ~756,970 events.
Marcus (Finance): that's ~0.757M embeds. At $0.0004/embed (customer plan) that's ~USD 302.79. Need approval to issue pro-rated credit against INV-2026-03-77.
Elena (CFO): tag me. we need the audit trail, replay id, and SRE sign-off. also confirm this wasn't double-billed due to any ratecap credit rules.
Li (Eng): audit attached: replay_id=rep-2287, s3://replays/rep-2287/logs.gz, sha256: 3b2f... (checksums included). I verified no duplicate billing markers in the replay pipeline.
billing-bot: Reconcile result: original billed=1,080,345; adjusted post-replay=1,837,315; delta=756,970. Proposed credit USD 302.79 (rounded to USD 303.00 for ledger).
Marcus (Finance): requesting approval to issue USD 303.00 credit to ACME (INV-2026-03-77). @Elena please approve so I can action.
Elena (CFO): approved pending Legal signoff. @Legal please review policy/precedent. :white_check_mark: 
Li (Eng): quick ops note: proxy-dedupe-v2 rule rolled back at 2026-03-12T03:20Z and we added an explicit metric. will post a short postmortem.
Anna (SRE): incident stub will go to #incidents with replay id rep-2287; artifacts retained for 90 days.
Marcus (Finance): thanks all — I'll hold the credit until Legal clears, then notify customer and apply.
Legal (Legal): reviewed contract; no blocking terms. approve credit; require redaction of any customer PII before sharing replay logs with ACME. Keep ticket FIN-2287 annotated.
Marcus (Finance): will redact and send redacted logs to ACME, then close the ticket. Closing loop.
